vision: Build an intelligent customer support chatbot powered by machine learning and natural language processing to efficiently handle user inquiries, reduce response time, and improve customer satisfaction.
scope: The epic covers chatbot design, integration with existing CRM, NLP training, conversation flow design, testing, and analytics dashboard. It excludes human agent service and multilingual support in the initial release.
success_criteria: Chatbot answers at least 80% of common inquiries accurately
Average resolution time is reduced by 40% compared to manual support

user_stories.title: Develop intelligent chatbot greeting and intent recognition using NLP
user_stories.i_want: the chatbot to greet me personally and accurately understand my inquiry using NLP
user_stories.so_that: I can receive quick and relevant assistance without needing human intervention

acceptance_criteria.given: a visitor opens the chat widget
acceptance_criteria.then: a personalized greeting is displayed using available profile or session data, followed by a prompt for the visitor’s inquiry

acceptance_criteria.given: the visitor sends a question or message
acceptance_criteria.when: the NLP engine processes the input
acceptance_criteria.then: intent and entities are extracted with a confidence score of at least 80% and categorized into preconfigured topics

acceptance_criteria.given: the NLP confidence score is below 80%
acceptance_criteria.then: the chatbot asks one or more clarification questions to refine understanding before proceeding

acceptance_criteria.given: a confident intent classification is achieved
acceptance_criteria.then: the chatbot summarizes the detected intent and offers next steps or response suggestions to the visitor

user_stories.title: Integrate chatbot with CRM to securely retrieve and personalize customer data during conversation
user_stories.i_want: the chatbot to automatically and securely retrieve verified customer data from the CRM system during interactions
user_stories.so_that: it can provide context-aware, data-driven, and personalized support while maintaining compliance and ensuring reliability even under error scenarios

acceptance_criteria.given: a user initiates a chat and their identity is verified
acceptance_criteria.when: the chatbot connects to the CRM through a secure API
acceptance_criteria.then: customer details such as name, purchase history, and open support tickets are retrieved and used to personalize responses

acceptance_criteria.given: the chatbot retrieves CRM data successfully
acceptance_criteria.then: PII is masked and handled in accordance with GDPR and internal data protection policies

acceptance_criteria.given: the CRM service is unavailable or returns an error
acceptance_criteria.then: a fallback response informs the user that personalized data cannot be accessed at the moment, without exposing error codes or system details
the reply references relevant historical interactions or transactions to enhance customer experience

acceptance_criteria.given: CRM returns incomplete or outdated data
acceptance_criteria.when: the chatbot detects missing key fields
acceptance_criteria.then: the chatbot logs the anomaly, avoids using stale data, and continues the conversation using fallback general responses

acceptance_criteria.given: multiple concurrent chat sessions request the same CRM endpoint
acceptance_criteria.then: the system handles requests asynchronously without data leakage or session mixing

acceptance_criteria.given: data retrieval takes longer than the defined timeout threshold
acceptance_criteria.when: the CRM query exceeds response time limit
acceptance_criteria.then: the chatbot notifies the user of delay and continues conversation using cached or default responses

user_stories.title: Enable admins to monitor chatbot performance through a real-time analytics dashboard
user_stories.i_want: to view detailed performance metrics of the chatbot including engagement trends, accuracy, and SLA compliance
user_stories.so_that: I can assess chatbot efficiency, identify improvement opportunities, and make data-driven decisions on training and optimization

acceptance_criteria.given: an admin logs into the analytics dashboard
acceptance_criteria.when: the system loads performance metrics from the analytics service
acceptance_criteria.then: the dashboard displays charts for daily conversation volume, average response time, intent accuracy percentage, and user satisfaction ratings

acceptance_criteria.given: the admin selects a specific date range or metric filter
acceptance_criteria.then: dashboard updates automatically to reflect only data within the selected timeframe or filtered metric category

acceptance_criteria.given: the admin reviews performance anomalies or trends
acceptance_criteria.when: an anomaly is detected (e.g., drop in accuracy or spike in volume)
acceptance_criteria.then: the dashboard highlights the issue visually and provides contextual insight or suggested corrective actions
a CSV or PDF report is generated containing summarized performance metrics and graphs for offline review
